subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw support intentional same-prompt-until-STOP execution as a core agent mode, expose the missing runtime hook so a plugin can own it, or decline the capability?
rationale: Current safety detectors, run retries, and the iteration-budget PR do not settle the product semantics or ownership boundary for an intentional autonomous loop.

options.title: Expose a plugin run-loop hook
options.body: Add the smallest safe runtime API needed for a ClawHub plugin to own Ralph orchestration and per-agent plugin configuration.

options.title: Add an opt-in core mode
options.body: Define and implement a distinct core Ralph contract with explicit STOP, interrupt, state, precedence, and bounded/unlimited semantics.

options.title: Decline native support
options.body: Keep existing external supervisor and skill patterns as the supported approach without adding core or plugin API surface.

recommendation.title: Expose a plugin run-loop hook
recommendation.body: Add the smallest safe runtime API needed for a ClawHub plugin to own Ralph orchestration and per-agent plugin configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They have already reviewed this item and have the strongest combined history across the relevant agent runtime, config, and loop-safety surfaces.
